title: Prototype Engineer, Smart Devices (m/f/d)
description:
Join our lab to turn ideas into working models.

What you'll do
- Build prototypes with 3D printing, Arduino and Raspberry Pi
- Support tests and write short reports

What you bring
- Degree in engineering or mechatronics, 1-2 years of experience
- Existing right to work in Germany is required; unfortunately we cannot offer visa sponsorship
- Good English
